captions.detailed: A pedestal-style arcade machine featuring a dark blue cabinet, a black base, and a black control panel. The upper section includes a yellow marquee panel above a dark rectangular screen. The control panel is outfitted with a central spinner dial and two small arcade buttons (one red, one blue). At the rear, a grey electronics access cover is mounted on the vertical pedestal column.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated pedestal arcade machine with a dark blue cabinet, a wide marquee head, and a black control ledge. The model must include a rotatable spinner dial, two spring-like prismatic buttons (red and blue), and a rear electronics cover rotating on a vertical hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the main pedestal and head cabinet using Box primitives joined together, applying a dark blue material. Create the base and control panel as separate black Box elements. Model the spinner as a flat Cylinder on a thin spindle, and model the buttons as small Cylinders nested inside cylindrical guides. Finally, construct the rear door as a thin Box, and define the articulations: continuous rotation for the spinner, prismatic translation for the buttons, and revolute rotation for the rear door.
